coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth variable items (67%): weight-only quantization with FP16 activations and unquantized KV caches, WikiText-2 evaluation with 2048-token windows, an FP16 baseline, 2/3/4-bit weights, the four method combinations represented by RTN/GPTQ crossed with rotation OFF/ON, and perplexity.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses symmetric per-channel quantization and optional grouping rather than fixed per-column asymmetric quantization. Makes 13B optional and explicitly excludes required 70B experiments. Its stability analysis concerns variance rather than detecting Inf/NaN failures. It also introduces additional calibration, grouping, and accuracy axes beyond the target design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth findings.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no results or conclusion establishing QuaRot-GPTQ's low-bit improvements, RTN failure patterns, partial stabilization of RTN, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
